detail: The separately published first-choice spreadsheet reports 24944/22920/22678/8182 votes; the final ranked-choice summary reports 24966/22933/22712/8194. Normalized results use round 1 of the final ranked-choice report. All three rounds and exhausted ballots are retained separately; the initial plurality leader is not the declared winner.

The official report and API mark results official, but the report displays incomplete/partially-reported precinct counters. Figures are retained as reported; these counters are not silently treated as proof of precinct completeness.

Asterisks are preserved in the original report but not interpreted as winner flags. In the Republican second-district primary, the starred candidate has fewer reported votes than the unstarred candidate.

The Washington county worksheet contains 'wa' rather than a numeric vote total for Ammie Akin in District 7. District 7 is excluded pending clarification. Districts 1, 2 and 6 are separately reconciled from all county portions to statewide totals.
May 19 congressional primaries in Districts 1, 2, 6 and 7 were replaced by August 11 primaries. Old observations remain explicitly superseded and cannot fill current nomination gaps.

Louisiana calls the November all-candidate ballot an open primary; the FEC calendar describes it as the federal general election with no separate congressional party primary. It remains a distinct nonpartisan record and must not be compared as a closed Democratic primary.
